raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Historic Environment Scotland page by treating the 1207 designation of Spynie church as the cathedral as a “precise founding year” for Spynie Palace. This conflated a cathedral event with the founding of the episcopal residence/palace, which the source indicates began in the late 1100s (late 12th century), with earliest surviving buildings from the 1300s and “palace” as a term appearing later. This led to an incorrect, overly precise founding year (1207) instead of the supported range (late 12th century, around 1200).
